selectedAssets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original Capydoku iOS game character sprite animation sheet, joyful victory variant.
Input image 1 is our own existing CapyMascot style/identity reference, not an edit target.
Create one horizontal sprite strip with exactly THREE equal square cells in a single row (3:1 canvas). Each cell has a genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha, no white/matte/checkerboard. No grid or text.
Across all three cells show the SAME full-body warm golden-brown chubby capybara, big rounded rectangular brown snout, tiny pink ears, dark brown rounded paws, creamy belly, fine dark brown clean outline and softly shaded polished casual game illustration exactly consistent with the reference. Keep its size, body proportions, perspective (slightly right facing), center x within each cell and ground baseline matched. Keep entire body and raised paws inside each square, leaving generous 12% safe margin.
The three cells are three actual distinct key poses of a joyful arm-raise celebration: LEFT anticipates, crouched a little, paws drawn together in front of belly, excited open eyes and little smile; MIDDLE is full cheerful stretch, BOTH little arms raised outward above shoulder level, wide closed happy eyes, open delighted smile, body lifted and feet slightly outward; RIGHT settles seated upright with BOTH paws still up and happily spread, eyes softly happy and broad smile. The pose change must genuinely redraw arms, shoulders, face, and legs, not merely scale/rotate one static picture. All faces capybara, no rabbit teeth.
No props, stars, confetti, clothes, accessories, text, borders, shadows on background, duplicate limbs, cropped ears/paws. Character itself retains natural shaded form. Sheet is intended for equal-cell slicing at runtime and harmonious 140px game UI.
selectedAssets.visualReview: Accepted after viewing: clasped paws anticipation, both arms up with open cheerful mouth, settled raised paws and happy smile. Three actual silhouettes/expressions; no props or extra limbs.

selectedAssets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original Capydoku iOS game character sprite animation sheet, gentle failure/retry variant.
Input image 1 is our own existing CapyMascot identity reference. Input image 2 is our existing CapySad emotion reference. Match their character, warm palette and finish. Create one horizontal sprite strip with exactly THREE equal square cells in a single row (3:1 canvas). Each cell has a genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha, no white/matte/checkerboard. No grid or text.
Across all three cells show the SAME full-body warm golden-brown chubby capybara, big rounded rectangular brown snout, exactly two eyes, two tiny pink ears, dark brown rounded paws, creamy belly, fine dark brown clean outline and softly shaded polished casual game illustration. Same slightly right facing perspective. Keep apparent body size, center x within each cell and seated ground baseline matched. Entire body inside its square, leaving 10% safety margin.
The three cells are real distinct key poses of a short disappointed sigh with an encouraging recovery: LEFT sits upright startled-disappointed, paws clasped near chest, sad brows and downturned mouth, no tears; MIDDLE lowers its head and rounds its shoulders into a soft slouch, eyes closed, forepaws rest limply on knees, small pursed sigh mouth; RIGHT gently lifts its head a little with a determined but still sad small expression, one paw held near chest and other resting on its knee as if ready to try again. Actual redraw of head angle, arms, shoulders and face between frames, not rotation/scaling one static image.
No tear drops, no despair, no injury, no props, floating particles, clothes, accessories, text, borders, shadows on background, duplicate limbs, cropped ears/paws. Keep lovable and warm, readable at 140px game UI. Intended for equal-cell sprite slicing.
selectedAssets.visualReview: Accepted after viewing: clasped worried paws, genuine head/shoulder slouch with closed eyes and sigh mouth, head lifts with one paw near chest. Gentle disappointed expression, no tears or distress imagery.

packaging: Generated PNGs copied unchanged into versioned asset sets. Genuine generated alpha preserved. Runtime crops equal square cells and downsamples to 512 px, preserving common canvas/baseline. No external image edits or generated-image replacements of pre-existing assets.
animation: Finite discrete contents keyframes display redrawn key poses in sync with existing Core Animation body motion. No timer or infinite loop; final model layer uses the new terminal pose. Existing event consumption, cleanup token, background/overlay/resize cancellation, Reduce Motion and low-power behavior retained.
newTests: AppTests/ResultCharacterChoreographyTests.swift: actual atlas alpha/seams/distinct pixels for all nine poses; malformed/missing fallback caching; fresh contents sequence and cancellation terminal pose; reduced-motion static expressive pose/no replay; actual small-host choreography contact sheet at nominal 100/350/900 ms for all three performances.
existingTests: AppTests/ResultCharacterTests.swift unchanged: lifecycle, duration, event deduplication, background/attachment/resize, touch pass-through, bounds and visual evidence.
limitations: Three key poses per performance, not a fully rigged continuously deforming character.
No audio generated or added by this subtask.
Host runtime results and aesthetic in-app assessment must be recorded after root's unified run; resource validation alone is not that proof.

resourceAudit.edgeTolerance: Meaningful alpha >16/255. The retry middle frame has two generated edge pixels of alpha 1/255; no visible contour crosses any cell edge. Original pixels preserved.
